name: Port2Port

delivery.note: A marketplace of many producers/vendors, not one retailer. Standard shipping is ~R110 nationwide; many individual sellers on the marketplace waive it above roughly R1,500-1,750. Free shipping is NOT a blanket guarantee the way it is at GetWine - must be checked per seller within a cart, not assumed.

constraints: Both mixed cases and single bottles available, unlike GetWine's 6-bottle minimum.
SA wine bottle prices seen: R165-R370 typical, running a bit above a typical day-to-day wine budget - would need singles/specials to balance the average.
South African fulfilment runs through Norman Goodfellows' warehouses - see vendors/norman-goodfellows.json. Ordering direct from NGF may be simpler than via this marketplace layer.
1-2 business days to main centres, 3-4 to outlying areas.
